title: Audio Margin
user: Students and professionals attending Spanish-language classes or meetings who need private, time-linked notes and recall prompts from recordings.
smallest_useful_product: A desktop-local app that runs a selectable on-device Spanish speech model, shows a time-linked transcript, and lets users pin a sentence with their own note/question; session view caps the next review at five pins.
success_measure: In pilot use, 60% of sessions produce 3–8 pinned prompts and users revisit at least one pin within seven days.
constraints: Support deletion and Spanish regional variants
